thesis: Remote engineering delivers an approved bounded task; the receiving cell accepts it, owns local execution and returns an accountable result.
changes: Full-screen aircraft title cover, including zero-time deep links.
Short chapter gaps and ending hold; same saved Kersh take/profile and speaking speed.
Personal introduction and disclaimer removed from current audio/script/captions.
Three-part bright 3D handoff overview with optional seven-check inspection.
Titles, inputs and outcomes on every visual.
Layered package matches narration; robot view appears during local work.
Diagram footers fit above captions; movie includes a captured title card without playback buttons.

TDD.scope: Presentation behavior and editorial contracts; failures retained.

EDD.scope: Source-linked local visuals and objective media verification, not execution or hardware acceptance.

CDD.scope: One edited speech/caption/event clock, unchanged voice profile, existing execution contracts unchanged.

BDD.scope: All chapters, cue alignment, title/inputs/outcomes, responsive cover and caption clearance.

CBT.scope: Actual browser scene/body and separately captured title through encoding and local media delivery.

retained_failures: Sample-rate timestamp rounding initially rejected an aligned word; fixed with one-sample tolerance.
Initial caption-gap assertion lacked floating-point tolerance.
Early navigation test expected technical controls to survive seeking; default intentionally returns to the audience view.
Early synchronization test needed initialization wait.
Early process footer overlapped captions; corrected framing and retained screenshots.
Draft body recording interrupted for the final caption-clearance correction.
Two broad UI tests timed out under concurrent recording load; unchanged limits passed with a single worker.
amber: New Intel/Red Hat hardware, physical integration, inspection accuracy and real-time behavior still require separate acceptance.
Business savings and production value remain unmeasured.
Hosted CI is separate from local checks; earlier runs had an account billing block.
smallest_next_hardware_gate: Named central/edge hosts, one bounded simulator task, transfer/disconnect/recovery and independent scoped evidence before any physical profile.
